name: Enphase Envoy solar
summary: Solar production now and today from your Enphase Envoy (IQ Gateway), plus home use and grid power if it has consumption meters.
description: Reads the Envoy's local API on your network (https://<envoy>/api/v1/production and /production.json) with an owner token, for firmware 7 and later. The Envoy uses a self-signed certificate, which this app accepts. Get a token at entrez.enphaseenergy.com (sign in with your Enlighten account, choose your site and gateway serial number); owner tokens last a year. Home use and grid power need consumption CTs; without them the reply shows production only. Grid power is positive when importing and negative when exporting.
author: MeshHome

settings.label: Envoy address
settings.help: The IP address or hostname of your Envoy / IQ Gateway on your network (envoy.local often works).

settings.label: Owner token
settings.help: From entrez.enphaseenergy.com: sign in with your Enlighten account, choose your site and the gateway's serial number, then create the token. It expires after a year.

reply.empty: The Envoy reported no production figures.
reply.unavailable: The Envoy isn't answering right now.
